remittances.title: Remittances
remittances.info: A remittance groups pending receipts into a single SEPA file to send to the bank. Once processed, returned receipts can be imported back to mark the ones the bank could not collect.
remittances.dueDateWeekend: That date falls on a weekend, which is not a settlement day. The bank may move it or reject it.
remittances.confirmSubmit: Mark this remittance as submitted to the bank?
remittances.confirmClose: Close this remittance? This finalizes the batch.
remittances.confirmCloseDescription: {count, plural, one {# receipt will be marked as paid} other {# receipts will be marked as paid}}. Once the remittance is closed, returns can no longer be imported.
remittances.confirmCancel: Cancel this remittance? All receipts will be unlinked.
remittances.selectReceiptsDesc: Select emitted or overdue receipts with active SEPA mandates
remittances.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# receipt selected} other {# receipts selected}}
remittances.importReturnsDesc: Paste the return data as JSON, in the shape shown in the box.
remittances.importIgnored: Unchanged: their status does not allow a return
remittances.importReturnsInvalidJson: The pasted text is not a valid JSON list.
